why: A touch-only device has no key to press, so a key hint there is an instruction the player cannot follow -- the acceptance criterion 'touch-only devices show no key hints'.

createRouteHost: prompts follow the input the player is using (issue #496) the first input of the page sets the hint with no threshold: a touch tap drops the key hint
keyHint: one policy for static hints across the HUD (issue #496) names the key for a keyboard, a pad's button only when one is bound, nothing for touch, and keeps the key for a mouse
